frame_identity.interpretation: The H-frame nu_out/nu_in factor is the transformed combination of proper-density incident flux, the atom-frame Kramers-Heisenberg-Waller frequency ratio, and the outgoing frequency-solid-angle Jacobian. Do not multiply both rho_star and r_H in an event push-forward implementation.

route_M_route_C.monolithic_definition: K_{a<-b} is the full opacity-times-redistribution rate.
route_M_route_C.rule: Route C is exactly equivalent to Route M only when Gamma is the column sum of the same monolithic kernel. Using an independently frozen Voigt opacity changes the collision operator.
